items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson was a full participant in Wednesday practice for the first time since his ankle injury, marking strong progress toward return vs Bills.
items.why: First full practice since ankle injury; Rapoport and Schefter confirm; expected to play per prior reports.
items.implication: Major unlock for Ravens offense and fantasy upside for pass-catchers and Henry.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers YPRR leader with Huntley; even higher ceiling with Lamar; red-zone/ dual-threat boost.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) listed as non-participant at Wednesday practice.
items.why: Shoulder issue post-Week 7; no indication of missing Sunday vs Vikings per reports, possibly rest/precaution.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday; high-end RB1 if active, handcuff watch if limited.
items.opportunity: If out/limited, David Montgomery or others elevate; usage still elite when healthy (RB1 PPG).

items.text: Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) was a non-participant at Wednesday practice.
items.why: Ankle from Sunday; Campbell indicated should be fine, rest day likely.
items.implication: Expected active vs Vikings; confirm rest of week. WR1/2 lock if playing.
items.opportunity: Jameson Williams volume bump if limited/out; Lions offense still elite.

items.text: Jadarian Price is BACK. But can you put him right back into your fantasy football lineup?
items.why: Seahawks opening 21-day window; eligible Week 8 vs CHI but crowded backfield (Charbonnet etc).
items.implication: Stash/monitor snaps; not automatic start until role clear. Flex only if volume.
items.opportunity: Potential committee; early-season promise but depth chart competition.
items.conflict: Usage may lag return due to committee.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba ripping off 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies despite losing Kubiak, shaded coverage, and limited supporting threats. Truly special.
items.why: Massive overperformance vs expected points from opportunity/routes/targets; data-driven.
items.implication: Sustainable elite WR1 due to talent transcending scheme/QB/supporting cast issues.
items.opportunity: High YPRR/target share continues; start with confidence ROS.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle suffered aggravation of previous chest injury on reverse last week; status for Sunday vs Chiefs TBD based on practice.
items.why: Aggravated prior chest; practice will determine availability.
items.implication: Monitor closely; if out, Courtland Sutton/others rise in DEN offense.
items.opportunity: Potential volume to Sutton, RJ Harvey if limited.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice (hamstring) returned as limited participant in Wednesday practice, first since Week 4.
items.why: First practice since hamstring in Week 4; Reid optimistic trajectory.
items.implication: Trending toward possible Week 8 return vs DEN; WR2 upside if active.
items.opportunity: Target share reclaim from Worthy/others; Mahomes unlock.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in yards per route run despite 64% targets from Huntley. Ravens 6th in YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Extremely excited for Declan Doyle/Lamar healthy impact.
items.why: Elite efficiency (YPRR leader) with backup QB; full Lamar unlocks higher volume/ceiling.
items.implication: Flowers WR1 upside spikes with Jackson return; must-start.
items.opportunity: Routes + Lamar dual-threat creates more big-play/red-zone chances.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love returns to practice (noted on Wednesday injury report).
items.why: Returns amid lengthy Cards injury report.
items.implication: Potential role expansion or committee; monitor snaps vs DAL.
items.opportunity: Depth chart movement in ARI backfield if healthy.

items.text: Sell Chris Olave or Jordyn Tyson? Give me Olave. I’d rather sell the unproven rookie.
items.why: Prefer moving proven but inconsistent Olave over stashing unproven Tyson talent/schedule.
items.implication: Trade Olave while value holds; Tyson stash for upside.
items.opportunity: Olave target share exists but NO offense volatility; sell high-ish.

items.text: Keeping it open on Sam LaPorta; could be in for a big day vs Vikings defense sure to pressure Goff.
items.why: Matchup leverage vs pressure-heavy Vikes; TE upside in Lions offense.
items.implication: Strong start candidate; TE1 upside this week.
items.opportunity: Red-zone/targets if Gibbs/St. Brown managed; Goff checkdowns.

items.text: Eagles placed RB Dameon Pierce on injured reserve and signed RB Jaydon Blue to active roster.
items.why: Roster move confirmed by team and Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Clears path for other backs; Saquon primary, Gainwell/Blue depth.
items.opportunity: Kenny Gainwell handcuff/backup snaps increase slightly.

items.text: Bengals listed WR Ja'Marr Chase as non-participant Wednesday due to ankle injury and rest.
items.why: Rest + ankle management common for stars midweek.
items.implication: Likely full later; elite WR1 expected to play. Tee Higgins/others monitor.

items.text: Lions full-PPR PPG: Goff QB2, Gibbs RB1 (3.9 clear of Walker), St. Brown WR4 (behind only JSN/Puka/Lamb), LaPorta TE6, Jameson Williams WR24. Zero surprise given talent/schedule/defense woes of others.
items.why: Dominance in scoring rates across skill positions despite any injuries.
items.implication: Start all core Lions skill players with high confidence; elite environment.
